Question Paper  
Exam Date & Time: 31-Dec-2025 (09:30 AM - 12:30 PM)  
  
  
  MANIPAL ACADEMY OF HIGHER EDUCATION  
  FIRST SEMESTER B.TECH. DEGREE EXAMINATIONS - DEC 2025/JAN 2026  
  SUBJECT: ECE 1071/ECE_1071 BASIC ELECTRONICS  
  BASIC ELECTRONICS [ECE 1071]  
Marks: 50                                                                                                    Duration: 180 mins.  
  
  A  
Answer all the questions.  
  
1A)               A PN-junction germanium diode has a saturation current of 1µA for an applied forward voltage of        (4)  
  0.2V at 27 o C. Determine the static and dynamic resistance. Also calculate the reverse saturation  
  current when temperature rises to 47o C.  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO1" / Cognitive Level: "Analysis"  
  
1B)               With a neat diagram, explain the structure and operation of MOSFET. Also, sketch and explain the       (3)  
  ID-VGS and ID-VDS characteristics.  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO2" / Cognitive Level: "Understand"  
  
1C)               With the help of an appropriate circuit, input & output waveforms, explain the working of a full wave (3)  
  center-tap rectifier with capacitor filter.  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO2" / Cognitive Level: "Understand"  
  
2A)               A full wave Bridge rectifier circuit is fed by ac mains of rms 230 V, 50 Hz supply through a           (4)  
  transformer having turns ratio of 10:1. If the load resistance is 1kΩ, assuming the diode resistance  
  to be zero, determine  
  (i) Average output voltage.  
  (ii) Average load current.  
  (iii) Output DC power.  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO2" / Cognitive Level: "Analysis"  
  
2B)               In a voltage regulator using Zener diode, the output voltage V0 =5V, Input voltage                     (3)  
  Vi= (12±3) V, RS =1kΩ, Load current IL =20mA. Find the minimum and maximum currents flowing  
  through the Zener diode.  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO2" / Cognitive Level: "Analysis"  
  
2C)               Explain with a neat circuit diagram how op-amp works as differentiator and derive the expression       (3)  
  for output voltage.  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO3" / Cognitive Level: "Understand"  
  
3A)               Derive the expression for the output voltage of a non-inverting op-amp amplifier with a neat circuit   (4)  
  diagram. Find the output voltage for input Vin= 2sin(2π100t). Given ±Vcc =15V, RF= 10kΩ and R1 =  
  2kΩ. Plot both input and output waveforms indicating all features in it.  
  
  Page #1

Course Outcome: "CO3" / Cognitive Level: "Analysis"  
  
3B)            A hexadecimal numbers B(16) is transmitted using a (7,4) Hamming code with even parity. During             (3)  
  transmission, an error occurs in the 3rd bit of the codeword. Analyse and determine what is the  
  received codeword, showing all steps of reasoning.  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO4" / Cognitive Level: "Analysis"  
  
3C)                                                                                                                            (3)  
  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO4" / Cognitive Level: "Analysis"  
  
4A)            Using KMAP, Deduce the simplified Boolean expression and implement it using only NAND gates                (4)  
  for the following expression.  
  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO4" / Cognitive Level: "Analysis"  
  
4B)            With aid of relevant circuit, truth table and timing diagram explain working of negative edge              (3)  
  triggered JK flip-flop.  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO3" / Cognitive Level: "Analysis"  
  
4C)            Analyze the operation of a 4-bit Serial-In Parallel-Out (SIPO) shift register by interpreting its truth    (3)  
  table and deducing its logical circuit for input data sequence of 1011. Explain how data propagates  
  through the flip-flops with each clock pulse.  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO3" / Cognitive Level: "Analysis"  
  
$$5A)            Given an FM equation VFM(t)=10cos[2\pi 108t+5sin(2 \pi  15000t)], Calculate Carrier frequency.                   (4)$$  
  Modulating frequency. Frequency deviation. Bandwidth using Carson's rule.  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO3" / Cognitive Level: "Evaluate"  
  
5B)            Apply your understanding of communication systems to explain its components using a labeled                (3)  
  block diagram.  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO3" / Cognitive Level: "Evaluate"  
  
5C)            Given Binary information 10110101 plot ASK, FSK and PSK wave forms.                                        (3)  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO3" / Cognitive Level: "Evaluate"
